bandReport.notes: Band holds items 1-23 (not 25): p10-c2 ends with item 23 whole, followed by '[ P.T.O.', so items 24 onward start on p12 (next band). Item 1 is whole at the top of p02-c1. Column crops were clean on all five pages: no line sliced, every item number present at the top of its column, no item crosses the gutter. Faint Hindi show-through from the verso is visible on the crops and was ignored. All pages are English. En dashes kept as printed (List–I, LAMITIYE–2026, Cyclone–IV, COP–26, 2023–24, 2026–27). Item 23 statement 1 prints the decimal as a raised dot '11·2', kept verbatim. Item 4 prints the script name as 'Ol Chiki'.
